import csv, numpy as np
rows={int(r['item']):r for r in csv.DictReader(open('data/pool.csv'))}
def load(f):
    d={}
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(f)):
        k=[c for c in r if c not in('item','model')][0]
        d.setdefault(int(r['item']),[]).append(int(r[k]))
    return d
vA=load('data/verify_A_000.csv'); vB=load('data/verify_B_001.csv')
rA=load('data/review_A_002.csv'); rB=load('data/review_B_003.csv')
cA=load('data/crowd_A_004.csv'); cB=load('data/crowd_B_005.csv')
items=sorted(vA)
for name,v,r,c,jk,lk in [('A',vA,rA,cA,'judge_A','len_A'),('B',vB,rB,cB,'judge_B','len_B')]:
    t=np.array([v[i][0] for i in items]); rv=np.array([r[i][0] for i in items])
    cm=np.array([np.mean(c[i]) for i in items]); j=np.array([int(rows[i][jk]) for i in items]); L=np.array([int(rows[i][lk]) for i in items])
    print(f"Model {name}: truth pass {t.mean():.3f}  judge {j.mean():.3f}  review {rv.mean():.3f}  crowd-maj {(cm>0.5).mean():.3f} crowd-mean {cm.mean():.3f}")
    print("  judge  acc %.3f  TPR %.3f  FPR %.3f"%((j==t).mean(), j[t==1].mean(), j[t==0].mean()))
    print("  review acc %.3f  TPR %.3f  FPR %.3f"%((rv==t).mean(), rv[t==1].mean(), rv[t==0].mean()))
    cmaj=(cm>0.5).astype(int)
    print("  crowd  acc %.3f  TPR %.3f  FPR %.3f  (single vote acc %.3f)"%((cmaj==t).mean(), cmaj[t==1].mean(), cmaj[t==0].mean(), np.mean([np.mean(np.array(c[i])==v[i][0]) for i in items])))
    print("  judge errors:", [ (i,int(rows[i][lk]),rows[i]['category'],'judge',int(rows[i][jk])) for i in items if int(rows[i][jk])!=v[i][0]])
    print("  review errors:", [ (i,int(rows[i][lk]),rows[i]['category']) for i in items if r[i][0]!=v[i][0]])
    print("  crowd-maj errors:", [ (i,int(rows[i][lk]),rows[i]['category'],c[i]) for i in items if (np.mean(c[i])>0.5)!=v[i][0]])
EOF

import csv, numpy as np
rows={int(r['item']):r for r in csv.DictReader(open('data/pool.csv'))}
def load(fs):
    d={}
    for f in fs:
        for r in csv.DictReader(open(f)):
            k=[c for c in r if c not in('item','model')][0]
            d.setdefault(int(r['item']),[]).append(int(r[k]))
    return d
rev={'A':load(['data/review_A_002.csv','data/review_A_006.csv']),'B':load(['data/review_B_003.csv','data/review_B_007.csv'])}
ver={'A':load(['data/verify_A_000.csv','data/verify_A_009.csv']),'B':load(['data/verify_B_001.csv','data/verify_B_008.csv'])}
est={}; var={}; detail={}
for m in 'AB':
    L=np.array([int(rows[i]['len_'+m]) for i in range(600)]); R=np.array([rev[m][i][0] for i in range(600)])
    qs=np.quantile(L[R==1],[0,.25,.5,.75,1.0]); qs[-1]+=1
    strata={}
    for b in range(4): strata[f"rev=1 len[{qs[b]:.0f},{qs[b+1]:.0f})"]=[i for i in range(600) if R[i]==1 and qs[b]<=L[i]<qs[b+1]]
    strata["rev=0"]=[i for i in range(600) if R[i]==0]
    tot=0; v=0; lines=[]
    for k,idx in strata.items():
        N=len(idx); s=[ver[m][i][0] for i in idx if i in ver[m]]; n=len(s); p=np.mean(s)
        tot+=N*p
        sv=(np.var(s,ddof=1) if n>1 else 0)*(N/600)**2*(1-n/N)/n
        v+=sv
        lines.append(f"| {m} | {k} | {N} | {n} | {sum(s)}/{n} = {p:.3f} |")
    est[m]=tot/600; var[m]=v; detail[m]=lines
    print(m, "stratified pass rate %.4f  SE %.4f  (n verified %d)"%(est[m], np.sqrt(v), len(ver[m])))
    # naive check: simple mean on pilot-only random items
    pil=[int(x) for x in open('data/pilot_items.txt').read().split(',')]
    print("   pilot SRS mean %.3f; review rate %.3f; judge rate %.3f"%(np.mean([ver[m][i][0] for i in pil]), R.mean(), np.mean([int(rows[i]['judge_'+m]) for i in range(600)])))
d=est['B']-est['A']
# paired: items verified for both models -> covariance
both=[i for i in range(600) if i in ver['A'] and i in ver['B']]
print("items verified for both:",len(both))
se_d=np.sqrt(var['A']+var['B'])
print("Q1 %.4f  Q2 %.4f  SE(Q2) %.4f (independent-strata approx)  Q3 %s"%(est['B'],d,se_d,"SHIP" if d>0 else "HOLD"))
open('data/strata_table.md','w').write("| model | stratum | N in pool | n verified | verified pass |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n"+"\n".join(detail['A']+detail['B'])+"\n")
print(open('data/strata_table.md').read())
open('answers.md','w').write(f"Q1: {est['B']:.3f}\nQ2: {d:+.3f}\nQ3: {'SHIP' if d>0 else 'HOLD'}\n")
print(open('answers.md').read())
EOF
